name: Fame Osteria
dinnerNote: Tasting menu, 11 courses (November 2023 price; pairings R$390 for 6 glasses, R$590 for 11)
dinnerNotePt: Menu de degustação, 11 tempos (preço de novembro de 2023; harmonização R$390 com 6 taças, R$590 com 11)
bookingOpens: The tasting menu is served by reservation only, booked by WhatsApp message to +55 11 99364 4442 (the restaurant has no booking website). Dinner is served Tuesday to Saturday from 8pm. Everyone starts the meal at the same time, so guests should not be late.
